summary: Specifies how a WebRTC data channel can carry real-time text conversation using the ITU-T T.140 format, and how SDP offer/answer negotiates it. This allows live text chat character by character in WebRTC calls. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: Sometimes people want to type to each other live, letter by letter, as if talking. This document explains how to send that typing through a WebRTC call's message lane.

questions: how to send real-time text over webrtc
